market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor federal deputy with negligible national profile and no realistic path to a second-place finish in a presidential election. Historically, second-place finishers in Brazil are major opposition figures, not obscure politicians. The market's 6% is grossly overpriced.
evidence_points: Renan Santos is a member of the Chamber of Deputies from São Paulo, not a national presidential contender.
In recent history (1989–2022), second-place candidates in the first round were always established political heavyweights (Lula, Bolsonaro, Alckmin, Serra, Aécio Neves, etc.).
Current polls for 2026 show Lula and Tarcísio de Freitas as likely frontrunners; Santos does not appear in any serious surveys.
